value.rationale: The exact closest face at fixed coordinate-deletion cardinality is a canonical metric invariant of transport polytopes. Two nontrivial structural regimes (partial matching vs biregular bipartite forbidden graph) classify all optimal support patterns, with explicit unique minimizing matrices and a degree-dispersion obstruction for all other feasible patterns. The result is infinite-family, sharp and tied to natural sparse and compatible dense k, rather than an arbitrary finite census.
